items.headline: Mitsubishi Electric's $1.4bn PCI deal reshapes ETRM market
items.summary: Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions reportedly valued the specialist ETRM vendor at roughly 17 times 2025 revenue, prompting other software owners to reassess their own valuations.

items.headline: OneCore Global wins patent for trade confirmations
items.summary: OneCore Global was granted a US patent covering dynamic-format electronic trade confirmations, aimed at reconciling differing data formats across commodity trading partners and markets.

items.headline: Trafigura closes $4.4bn syndicated loan facility
items.summary: Trafigura closed an upsized $4.4bn syndicated loan package, per GTR, underscoring continued bank appetite for large commodity trader financing despite past sector stress.

items.headline: Houthi attacks revive Red Sea shipping risk
items.summary: Houthi strikes on Saudi infrastructure have reportedly raised fresh concerns of Red Sea shipping disruption just as carriers negotiate 2027 freight contracts, according to FreightWaves.
